messages:
tess_rep: Heads-up: SunForge wants BYOK + explicit escrow refusal note and a temporary SLA uplift for their 2-day demo. Procurement says they won't countersign without it.
alejandra_legal: We can refuse escrow. propose: 'Customer retains control of keys; Redwood will not store or escrow customer keys. Support follows Redwood KMS Onboarding Guide.' ok?
sam_billing: Billing note: they want 50/50 activation split. Finance needs PO # and tax jurisdiction for activation fee.
kai_se: Tech asks: dedicated ingest endpoint and a no-training promise for POC inputs. Ops, can you provision isolated logs for the demo?
deploy_bot: env-create: sunforge-poc-sandbox provisioned. logs bucket gs://sunforge-poc (retention 14d).
alejandra_legal: SLA uplift: we can do a POC SLO 99.6% for scheduled demo windows (max 48 hrs) with exclusions for user-induced overloads. will draft a one-pager.
sam_billing: I'll add burst capacity as separate line item on the OF so procurement can approve quickly. creating draft INV-SF-0506.
tess_rep: Please fast-track. client needs signed OF by 05/04 to secure demo slots. I'll send the addendum once ready.
kai_se: I'll prepare the onboarding checklist for BYOK (metadata + thumbprint + rotation window) and the dedicated endpoint details.
alejandra_legal: Draft uploaded to legal-drafts/sunforge_poc_addendum_v1.docx. Reviewing then will attach to OF.
sam_billing: Sent PO instructions to procurement contact. awaiting PO.
tess_rep: Thanks all — i'll ping if client pushes for escrow language.
